title: alibertia elliptica

This plant is valued for its rich content of bioactive compounds, which are known to offer various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Alibertia elliptica are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit cardiotonic and vasodilatory effects, and display antidiabetic and antitumor activities. The bioactive constituents of Alibertia elliptica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
